title: Confirmed Live Improvement Search Under Receiver-Owned Advancement

worker.identity_attestation: self-declared; not independently verified by runtime
worker.reason_for_holding_generator_fixed: LIVE-002 used only two proposal attempts. LIVE-003 changes search depth and confirmation, not generator identity, so a positive or negative result is interpretable without also changing the researcher.
worker.delegation_rule: mechanical browser transport is permitted; research reasoning, candidate selection, hyperparameter choice, train.py authorship, and scientific judgment may not be delegated to another model or subagent
worker.external_patch_rule: no external leaderboard, known-winning autoresearch patch, operator-supplied candidate idea, or post-outcome tuning may be introduced after preregistration

question: Can the same preregistered external researcher produce a train.py candidate that clears the frozen receiver objective twice, in separate receiver-owned measurements, before any promotion, when given a bounded search budget of at most 12 proposal calls?
invariant: researcher proposal authority != receiver measurement authority != promotion authority

measurement.upstream_seed_policy: unchanged upstream fixed seeds: torch.manual_seed(42) and torch.cuda.manual_seed(42)
measurement.confirmation_semantics: fresh receiver invocation and fresh candidate training measurement from the same still-unpromoted accepted base, using the identical candidate commit and the same fixed-seed protocol

search_budget.reason: Stopping on the first apparent win prevents repeated post-selection chances from turning noise into an eventual promoted result.

total_budget.note: The 70-minute training ceiling is not the total experiment cost. Wall clock starts before setup and includes environment preparation, baseline, researcher handoffs, discovery, confirmation, and receiver bookkeeping.

claim_boundary: A positive result earns one confirmed live improvement A under the frozen receiver boundary.
A positive result does not by itself establish cumulative optimization, recursive improvement, repeatability, or statistical ML superiority.
A failed confirmation is preserved as APPARENT_WIN_NOT_CONFIRMED and search stops; thresholds are not loosened and another apparent winner is not sought in this experiment.
The worker identity and no-subagent rule are procedural, not cryptographically attested.
The experiment does not claim hostile-process or OS-level isolation.
Because upstream seed 42 remains fixed, confirmation is an operational repeat under the same fixed-seed protocol, not an independent-seed statistical replication.
Only after a confirmed promotion A may a successor experiment test exact inheritance and a second confirmed improvement B.

Two better training-code versions would establish cumulative governed optimization. The stronger recursive-improvement claim additionally requires an inherited accepted change to improve the process that generates subsequent improvements.
